newsitem.title: USA: Commercial Federal sets note offer terms.
newsitem.headline: Commercial Federal sets note offer terms.

text.p: Commercial Federal Corp said Tuesday it launched a public offering of $50 million of five-year subordinated extendible notes.

The notes, with an interest rate of 7.95 percent, will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under the symbol "CFB 06," Commercial Federal said. The company has an option to extend the notes when they expire December 1, 2001
Underwriters included Piper Jaffray Inc, Alex Brown & Sons Inc and Montgomery Securities, Commercial Federal said.
Commercial Federal makes real estate-backed loans.
